description: A sitting room vignette photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a small round accent table against a corner where two walls meet. The walls are a smooth, muted light grey with a slightly warm undertone, bare and clean. To the left, sheer white curtain fabric from an off-frame window allows soft diffused natural daylight to filter evenly across the scene. The table is a small round side table with a white Italian Carrara marble top, showing soft grey veining, and a slender geometric hairpin base in brass or antique gold. On the marble surface, three styling objects accompany the central glowing piece: two dark antique leather-bound hardcover books stacked together on the left, a small white painted frame leaning against the wall holding a text print in minimal black type, and a tiny dark bronze sculptural figurine — a small crouching figure object. The central glowing piece is a table-height decorative object with a round faceted crystal-clear textured glass drum shade, a white cylindrical stem, and a polished rose-gold to gold trumpet-flare base. Warm amber-gold light radiates softly from within the crystal glass drum and pools on the marble table surface and the adjacent wall. The mood is refined, Parisian, and softly glamorous. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
